subject: Request: >20% discount for MedLytics Hosted API commitment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: >20% discount for MedLytics Hosted API commitment

Hi team,

Quick context: MedLytics (SaaS health analytics) is asking for a 25% discount off our published Hosted API usage rates in return for a 12-month, committed-spend agreement. Their procurement contact is proposing a $90k annual commitment (roughly 4M tokens/month) and wants pricing and SOW today to hit their quarter close.

Why this is urgent: they were evaluating two other providers and our low-latency demo and privacy controls moved us to shortlist. Marissa has a strong product fit and they want preferential pricing to lock in the deal.

Requested ask: formal exec approval to offer 25% off standard unit rates for the 12-month committed term, with standard Hosted API T&Cs, 30-day payment terms, and the following concessions we WOULD like to include:
- Non-refundability on the initial three months of committed spend if they underutilize;
- Commitment auto-renew opt-out with 60 days' notice;
- Redwood retains right to revert to list pricing for any usage above the committed baseline.

Impact: pricing-analysis attached shows estimated blended gross margin ~34% at 25% discount given their usage profile and expected token mix. Finance flagged this as a material concession (>20%).

Can you confirm whether we can approve 25% as-is or if we need escalation to CFO/legal for non-standard clauses (payment terms or SLA additions)? If approved, I will send the SOW for signature and update the HubSpot deal.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: MedLytics_MSP_SOW_v2.pdf, pricing-analysis-medlytics-20260325.xlsx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: >20% discount for MedLytics Hosted API commitment

Thanks for the note and the analysis, Marissa — good summary. I reviewed the attached spreadsheet and did a quick scenario run. A couple of operational notes:

- The committed baseline (4M tokens/month) looks realistic based on their demo logs, but we should make the commitment calendarized (monthly consumption targets) and include a short rebaseline clause at month 3 to prevent extreme under-utilization.
- Finance is comfortable short-term with a 25% discount only if we keep 30-day payment terms and add the non-refundability clause you proposed. Anything longer than 30 days materially increases our cash risk.
- Legal (Stephanie) — do we need additional approval to bundle the non-refundability language into the SOW?

Recommendation to Rishi: approve 25% discount for this one-year committed Hosted API contract with the concessions listed above, and require a signed SOW + PO before the price takes effect. This keeps the deal competitive while protecting revenue.

If you (Rishi) can greenlight, I'll route the SOW to their procurement via DocuSign and schedule the kickoff.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Director, Deal Desk
dylan_brooks@redwood.example
+1 (415) 555-0199
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: >20% discount for MedLytics Hosted API commitment

Dylan / Marissa — thanks for the detail.

Approve conditionally. I will sign off on a 25% discount provided all the following are in place before pricing is executed:
1) Signed SOW and PO in DocuSign (no verbal commitments).
2) 12-month minimum term (no early termination without pro-rated payment).
3) 30-day net payment terms (Procurement must commit).
4) Inclusion of the non-refundability clause for the first 3 months and a month-3 consumption rebaseline in the SOW.

Finance: if they push for 45-60 day terms, escalate to CFO. Legal (Stephanie): please draft the non-refundability + rebaseline language and confirm there are no regulatory conflicts given MedLytics' healthcare focus.

Dylan: proceed to get DocuSign SOW to MedLytics; keep me updated if procurement pushes.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@medlytics.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example>, procurement@medlytics.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: MedLytics — Confirmed pricing & next steps (25% off)

Sanjay — great meeting earlier. Following internal approvals, we can confirm the pricing concession you requested. Summary below: 

- Discount: 25% off Redwood Hosted API published usage rates
- Commitment: 12 months, baseline 4M tokens/month (see SOW)
- Billing: monthly, net 30 days; SOW must be signed and PO submitted
- Special terms: non-refundable first 3 months of committed spend; month-3 consumption rebaseline (per SOW)

I've attached the final SOW and a short pricing appendix. Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/medlytics-sow-dslink

If you need us to loop in legal/procurement directly, let me know. We can aim to have the agreement countersigned by next week to get you on a May billing start.

Thanks — excited to partner,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example
